connector.name: Synapse Layer - Zero-Knowledge Memory
connector.registryDescription: Zero-Knowledge Context™ & Neural Handover™ for AI Agents. The Trust Layer for AI Memory.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package synapse-layer. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the synapselayer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SYNAPSE_AGENT_ID
env.description: Identifier for the agent using the memory layer (e.g., claude-desktop, my-agent).

env.name: SYNAPSE_PRIVACY_EPSILON
env.description: Differential privacy epsilon parameter. Lower values = stronger privacy. Range: 0.1–2.0.

env.name: SYNAPSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: AES-256-GCM encryption key for at-rest memory encryption. Auto-generated if not provided.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR. Default: INFO.
